facts.fact: The PADCI final report (V2.1, 18 November 2025) says Côte d'Ivoire has a Stratégie Nationale de Développement du Numérique 2021-2025, aligned with the PND 2021-2025, with the National Rural Connectivity Programme as a flagship component; the report is on the telecom ministry's site, but it does not say whether the strategy text itself is public.
facts.system: Stratégie nationale de développement du numérique 2021-2025

facts.fact: The report says the National Rural Connectivity Programme under the SNDN is in active deployment with some localities connected but implementation partial, with effective internet use still low; no result is measured against a stated SNDN target.
facts.system: Stratégie nationale de développement du numérique 2021-2025
